skill.name: nano-banana-blockrun
skill.description: Generate images through BlockRun with Nano Banana and other supported models. Requests use x402 micropayments in USDC on Base and require a wallet key.
skill.summary: Generate images through BlockRun with per-request USDC payments on Base.
skill.author: BlockRunAI

security_audit.summary: Most URL, hidden-directory, Git ignore, and Markdown fence detections are benign documentation. Confirmed risks involve plaintext wallet-key handling and transmitting prompts and payment signatures to BlockRun. Additional risks include an unpinned executable dependency with key access and paid requests without approval or spending limits.

remediation.issue: The setup places a raw wallet private key in an environment file or process environment.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated low-balance wallet or constrained signer, protect secret-file permissions, and never request a primary wallet key.

remediation.issue: The instructions install an unpinned package that operates while the wallet key is available.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and hash, publish a lock file, and link the audited signing implementation.

remediation.issue: Image requests can initiate USDC payments without a documented confirmation step or spending limit.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval showing model, maximum charge, and request count, then enforce per-request and session spending caps.

remediation.issue: The documentation references scripts/generate.py, but that file is absent from the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Include the reviewed script or remove every command that depends on it.

content.user_title: Generate Images with Nano Banana and USDC
content.value_statement: Image generation often requires separate API subscriptions and keys. This skill uses BlockRun to request supported models and pay per image with USDC on Base.
actual_capabilities: Uses the blockrun-llm ImageClient to submit text prompts.
Returns a generated image URL from the SDK response.
Documents Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, and DALL-E 3 options.
Explains x402 payment signing and Base network requirements.
Lists approximate per-image prices and supported resolutions.
limitations: Requires USDC on Base and access to a wallet private key.
Depends on the external BlockRun service and blockrun-llm package.
Each request spends funds, and documented prices are approximate.
The referenced scripts/generate.py file is absent from the audited package.

use_cases.title: Create Design Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate a single concept image after reviewing the selected model and estimated charge.

use_cases.title: Prototype Visual Assets
use_cases.description: Request temporary artwork for an application prototype without configuring a conventional image API key.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Drafts
use_cases.description: Develop approved image prompts and generate a controlled set of campaign drafts within a defined budget.

prompt_templates.title: Generate One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate one 1024x1024 image of [subject] in [style]. Before execution, state the selected model and estimated USDC charge.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one clearly scoped image.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product concept image for [product] with [background], [lighting], and [brand colors]. Use Nano Banana and request approval before payment.
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs a controlled concept render.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Nano Banana and Nano Banana Pro for [scene]. Explain price and resolution differences, then generate only the approved option.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants to balance quality and cost.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Budgeted Image Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan three campaign images with a total budget of [amount] USDC. Present prompts, model choices, and costs before making any paid requests.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs several coordinated images with strict spending control.

output_examples.input: Generate one image of a glass greenhouse at sunrise using Nano Banana.
output_examples.output: Selected Nano Banana at 1024x1024. Estimated charge is approximately $0.05 USDC. The paid request is awaiting approval.

output_examples.input: Create a detailed city poster and compare the standard and Pro models first.
output: Nano Banana Pro: approximately $0.10 for output up to 4K.
No request was sent. Select one option to approve its estimated charge.

output_examples.input: Generate an approved Nano Banana image of a red bicycle beside a lake.
output_examples.output: The image request completed. The SDK returned a hosted image URL for the generated result.

best_practices: Use a dedicated low-balance wallet and never expose a primary wallet key.
Confirm the model, estimated charge, and request count before each generation.
Pin and review the blockrun-llm package version before installing it.
anti_patterns: Do not store a funded primary wallet key in a project environment file.
Do not allow retries or batch generation without a strict spending limit.
Do not assume the referenced generation script exists in this package.

faq.question: Which models are documented?
faq.answer: The skill lists Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, and DALL-E 3.

faq.question: What payment method is required?
faq.answer: Requests use USDC on the Base network through the x402 payment flow.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: No conventional service API key is documented. The SDK requires access to a wallet private key for payment signing.

faq.question: How much does an image cost?
faq.answer: Documented prices range from about $0.04 to $0.12 per image. Actual charges can change.

faq.question: Does the private key leave the machine?
faq.answer: The documentation claims local signing, but the audited package does not include the SDK implementation needed to verify that claim.

faq.question: Can I use the documented generation script?
faq.answer: No scripts/generate.py file appears in the audited package. Use the documented SDK only after reviewing and pinning its dependency.
